description: Record's toasts: short messages over the bottom of the window (libadwaita toasts, 4 seconds; 6 for a name's card), sometimes with a button. A list of those Record shows, with their wording.

parts.name: notes and pages
parts.shows: "There's a page called {name} already" (a rename that would clash). "“{term}” added to To learn" with a button "Open" (Home). "Link copied" / "This page has no link to copy". "Transcript copied" / "No chat open".

parts.name: names and chats
parts.shows: "@{name}: not found in {folders}" or "@{name}: open a chat to look it up in its folder"; a name's card as a toast ("{name}: {kind} · {summary}", with "To notes" for a chat's name); "That chat isn't on this computer"; "That passage isn't in the chat any more"; "Citation link copied", "{n} citation links copied"; "Open a chat first: the viewers show its folder".
text: That chat isn't on this computer
Open a chat first: the viewers show its folder

parts.name: hosts
parts.shows: "{host} deactivated" / "{host} activated"; "{host}'s notebooks weren't listed: {why}"; "{host} didn't save the change: {why}"; "Restarting the daemon once {n} session(s) finish running a command"; "Daemon restarted"; "The daemon didn't start again: {log path} may say why".

parts.name: update
parts.shows: "Record updated" (with the number of new commits) after a restart onto a new version.
